description: No corticosteroids prescribed at discharge despite COPD exacerbation diagnosis and hospitalization.
evidence_in_history: Assessment at hospital included acute exacerbation of COPD; usual management often involves corticosteroids.
evidence_in_summary: Note states: 'Oral corticosteroids were not prescribed at discharge despite COPD exacerbation.'
suggested_correction: Document rationale for withholding corticosteroids or consider prescribing corticosteroids at discharge per COPD exacerbation guidelines.

description: Pulmonology follow-up appointment mentioned without specific date; primary care follow-up recommended with no timeframe specified.
evidence_in_history: 2012-05-25 routine visit recommended follow-up in 6 months but hospital discharge follow-up details lack specificity.
evidence_in_summary: Follow-up: 'Pulmonology appointment in 4 weeks (exact date not provided)' and 'Primary care provider follow-up recommended, no specific timeframe indicated.'
suggested_correction: Provide specific dates for pulmonology and primary care follow-up appointments in the discharge summary.

description: No documented recommendations or referrals for pulmonary rehabilitation despite prior recommendation during outpatient visit.
evidence_in_history: Office Visit 2 plan includes 'Recommend pulmonary rehab referral'.
evidence_in_summary: No documented recommendations for pulmonary rehabilitation in discharge summary.
suggested_correction: Include pulmonary rehabilitation referral or clear documentation regarding its consideration in the discharge summary.

description: No mention of vaccination status or recommendations at discharge, despite vaccination administration noted at prior outpatient visit.
evidence_in_history: Office Visit 2 includes administration of influenza and pneumococcal vaccines.
evidence_in_summary: No referral or instructions regarding influenza or pneumococcal vaccination status or schedule at discharge.
suggested_correction: Document vaccination status clearly and provide recommendations or reminders regarding vaccinations at discharge.

description: No documentation of venous thromboembolism (VTE) prophylaxis during hospitalization despite immobility risk; no documentation of home oxygen therapy or respiratory therapy plan at discharge.
evidence_in_history: Hospital course notes no VTE prophylaxis documented and no home oxygen plan documented at discharge.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary states 'No home health services arranged' and 'No clear respiratory therapy or home oxygen plan documented.'
suggested_correction: Document VTE prophylaxis plan during admission; provide clear discharge instructions regarding respiratory therapy and home oxygen if needed.

description: No follow-up laboratory monitoring scheduled or recommended despite mild acute kidney injury at admission.
evidence_in_history: Hospital course notes mild AKI with creatinine 1.3 mg/dL on admission.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary does not mention lab follow-up plans for kidney function monitoring.
suggested_correction: Include recommendations for monitoring renal function post-discharge given acute kidney injury during hospitalization.

description: Nutritional status and management not addressed during hospitalization or at discharge.
evidence_in_history: Hospital course states 'Nutritional status was not specifically addressed.'
evidence_in_summary: No documentation of nutritional assessment or recommendations at discharge.
suggested_correction: Document nutritional evaluation and provide dietary recommendations or referrals as appropriate in discharge summary.
